cases.name: text_wins_outright_no_derivation
cases.note: text is the visible label; derivation never runs when the node carries its own text

cases.name: content_desc_wins_when_text_absent
cases.note: content-desc is the fallback for an element carrying only a content description (an icon-only control)

cases.name: non_clickable_container_does_not_derive_a_label
cases.note: label derivation is scoped to clickable (interactive) nodes: a plain layout container with a text child stays label-less, so the tree is not flooded with synthetic container labels
cases.xml: <hierarchy><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="false" bounds="[0,0][100,100]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Inside" clickable="false" bounds="[0,0][50,50]" /></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: derives_from_single_non_clickable_descendant
cases.note: a Compose NavigationBarItem dumps as a clickable node with no own text/content-desc; its visible caption lives in a child TextView
cases.xml: <hierarchy><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,2120][200,2340]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Log" clickable="false" bounds="[10,2250][90,2300]" /></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: skips_nested_clickable_subtree
cases.note: a clickable descendant is its own control (its own button + derived label), so its text is not folded into the outer control's label
cases.xml: <hierarchy rotation="0"><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,2120][200,2340]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Log" clickable="false" bounds="[10,2250][90,2300]" /><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[100,2130][190,2180]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="9" clickable="false" bounds="[110,2130][180,2180]" /></node></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: skips_nested_clickable_subtree_badge_derives_its_own_label
cases.note: the same tree as the case above: the nested badge derives its own label from its own descendant, independent of the outer control
cases.xml: <hierarchy rotation="0"><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,2120][200,2340]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Log" clickable="false" bounds="[10,2250][90,2300]" /><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[100,2130][190,2180]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="9" clickable="false" bounds="[110,2130][180,2180]" /></node></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: derives_from_multiple_descendants_joined_in_document_order
cases.note: collect() is depth-first pre-order; a non-clickable child with text still has its own children explored too
cases.xml: <hierarchy><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,0][200,100]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Icon" clickable="false" bounds="[0,0][100,50]"><node class="android.widget.TextView" text="Caption" clickable="false" bounds="[0,50][100,100]" /></node></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: no_text_anywhere_derives_none
cases.note: an empty parts list joins to the empty string, which the `or None` in _derived_label degrades to an honest absence
cases.xml: <hierarchy><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,0][100,50]"><node class="android.widget.View" text="" clickable="false" bounds="[0,0][50,50]" /></node></hierarchy>

cases.name: descendant_content_desc_is_never_folded_into_the_join
cases.note: content-desc is this driver's value channel (SPEC §2.1 mirrors assertion state into it); a descendant carrying only content-desc contributes nothing to the derived label, even though content-desc alone would win outright at the node's own level (see content_desc_wins_when_text_absent)
cases.xml: <hierarchy><node class="android.view.View" text="" clickable="true" bounds="[0,0][100,50]"><node class="android.widget.ImageView" content-desc="decorative icon" clickable="false" bounds="[0,0][50,50]" /></node></hierarchy>
